title: Green Witch Under Umbrella
description: A green-skinned female figure with black curly hair crouches on wet cobblestones, holding a dripping blue umbrella. She wears a long black hooded cloak decorated with white line art of beetles, skulls, and occult symbols, with golden rings floating around her.
